Nad dvěma stejně vysokými vrcholy leží s: Stops sit above two equal highs. A wick takes them and the candle closes back below the level: that is a sweep.
Likvidita jsou místa na grafu, kde má ho: Liquidity is the places on the chart where many traders have their stop-losses. Whoever bought has a stop below some low. Whoever sold has it above a high.
Nejčitelnější jsou high a low předchozíh: The easiest to read are the previous day's high and low, the overnight session's high and low, and two highs or two lows at almost the same price (equal highs and lows). Price often heads to these places, takes the stops and then either turns (a sweep) or continues (a breakout).
Nejdřív si označ, kde leží stopy ostatní: First mark where other people's stops are. Only then ask where price will go.
Velká svíčka nechá mezeru mezi high prvn: A large candle leaves a gap between the high of the first candle and the low of the third. Price later returns to its midpoint.
FVG je mezera ve třech svíčkách po sobě:: An FVG is a gap in three consecutive candles: the wick of the first and the wick of the third don't overlap. It forms during a fast move in one direction, which is called displacement.
ICT čeká, až se cena do mezery vrátí, a: ICT waits for price to return into the gap and enters in the direction of the original move. The middle of the gap is called consequent encroachment (CE). Two independent tests also showed that the gap alone has no edge over an equally large zone in a random place, and that price returns to random levels too.
FVG má váhu jen tehdy, když ho vytvořil: An FVG has weight only when it was created by a strong move after a liquidity grab.
BOS potvrzuje trend. MSS je první zavřen: A BOS confirms the trend. An MSS is the first close against the trend.
Trend nahoru je řada vyšších vrcholů a v: An uptrend is a series of higher highs and higher lows. An MSS is the first candle that closes below the last higher low. In a downtrend it is the first close above the last lower high.
Neznamená jistý obrat, jen první varován: It doesn't mean a certain reversal, just a first warning. Our backtest and one test the bots found showed that waiting for the MSS did not improve results.
Počítá se zavření těla svíčky za úrovní,: The candle body close beyond the level counts, a wick alone does not.
Short: výběr likvidity nad vrcholem, zav: Short: a liquidity grab above the high, a close below the last low, an FVG and an entry at 50 % of the gap with the stop behind the sweep.
Model spojuje předchozí pojmy do jednoho: The model joins the previous concepts into one procedure: price takes liquidity (sweep), changes structure (MSS), leaves an FVG and you enter on the return into it. The stop is behind the sweep extreme.
Je to hypotéza, ne zaručený recept. Mech: It is a hypothesis, not a guaranteed recipe. The mechanical version of this procedure did not make money in our backtest on NQ.
Umět setup na grafu přesně poznat je prv: Being able to recognise the setup precisely on the chart is the first step. Whether it makes money is for a test to show.
Den v newyorském čase. Okna Silver Bulle: The day in New York time. The Silver Bullet windows are yellow, the Tape model window blue.
ICT hledá obchody jen v určitých hodinác: ICT looks for trades only in certain hours of New York time, mainly after the market open at 9:30. The Silver Bullet is three one-hour windows: 3:00 to 4:00, 10:00 to 11:00 and 14:00 to 15:00.
Čas je jen filtr. Testy, které boti našl: Time is only a filter. The tests the bots found did not show that the hour alone gives an edge.
Správná hodina bez sweepu a FVG není set: The right hour without a sweep and an FVG is not a setup.
Cena roste k high předchozího dne, kde l: Price rises to the previous day's high, where liquidity lies. The bias is long.
Bias je pracovní předpoklad, kterým směr: Bias is a working assumption about which way price is more likely to go today. ICT derives it from the question of which liquidity price is heading for (draw on liquidity).
Když se bias nepotvrdí, opouští se. Den: When the bias is not confirmed, it is dropped. A day without a clear direction is a day without a trade.
Bias není předpověď. Je to důvod brát ob: Bias is not a forecast. It is a reason to take trades in one direction only.
Pohyb ode dna k vrcholu rozdělený v půlc: The move from low to high split in half: expensive at the top, cheap at the bottom.
Poslední výrazný pohyb ode dna k vrcholu: The last significant move from low to high is split in half. The upper half is premium (expensive), the lower discount (cheap).
Nakupovat se má v discountu, prodávat v: You should buy in discount and sell in premium. According to ICT an FVG for a buy has more weight when it lies in the lower half.
Stejný FVG může být dobrý i špatný podle: The same FVG can be good or bad depending on whether it lies cheap or expensive.
Vzdálenost vstupu od stopu je 1R. Cíle s: The distance from entry to stop is 1R. Targets are measured in multiples of R.
R je částka, kterou na obchodu riskuješ:: R is the amount you risk on a trade: the distance from entry to stop. Profit and loss are both measured in R, so they can be compared regardless of money.
Stop patří tam, kde myšlenka obchodu pře: The stop belongs where the trade idea stops being valid, in our model behind the sweep extreme. When it comes out too far, the trade is not taken.
Při cíli 2R stačí vyhrát víc než třetinu: With a 2R target it is enough to win more than a third of trades. With 1R more than half.
Data se rozdělí podle času. Na starší čá: The data is split by time. Rules are tuned on the older part, the newer part only verifies whether they work.
Backtest je zkouška pravidel na historic: A backtest is a trial of rules on historical data. It shows how many trades the model would have made and how they would have turned out, including fees.
Pravidla se ladí na starší části dat (tr: Rules are tuned on the older part of the data (training) and verified on the newer part (test), which the model did not see during tuning. When the result disappears on the test, it was chance, not an edge. A profit factor above 1 means profit, below 1 a loss.
Věř jen číslům z dat, která model předem: Trust only numbers from data the model has not seen before.
Tolik procent obchodů dojde k cíli dřív: This many percent of trades reach the target before the stop when price moves randomly.
I náhodný vstup občas dojde k cíli. Když: Even a random entry reaches the target sometimes. When the target is as far as the stop (1R), chance hits it in roughly half the cases. A 2R target in about a third, a 3R target in about a quarter.
Model má výhodu jen tehdy, když jeho obc: A model has an edge only when its trades reach the target clearly more often. Our three variants so far come out the same as chance or worse.
Winrate sám nic neříká. Vždy ho porovnej: Win rate alone says nothing. Always compare it with what chance would give with the same target.
Vlevo malé svíčky klidného trhu, vpravo: On the left the small candles of a quiet market, on the right the large candles of an active market.
Volatilita říká, jak moc se cena za urči: Volatility says how much price moves over a certain time. It is measured for example by the range between the highest and lowest price of a session.
V klidném trhu jsou pohyby malé a cíle s: In a quiet market moves are small and targets are harder to reach. In an active market both stops and targets are further away. That is why the same setup behaves differently on different days.
Před seancí se podívej, jak velké bylo n: Before the session look at how large the overnight range was. It hints at how large the moves to expect are.
